name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 27 – Am 5
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 27. Calls on the Commission to follow up on the scientific evaluation of the health risks related to e-cigarettes, heated tobacco products, nicotine pouches and novel tobacco products, including the assessment of the risk of using these products compared to consuming other tobacco products, in accordance with EU law; stresses, too, that smoking cessation strategies and policies must be strictly aligned with scientific evidence relying on proven, independently verified and, where appropriate, clinically supervised methods; calls for enhanced monitoring and data collection on dual use and on the rising uptake of consumption of nicotine among non-smokers, young people and minors, to support evidence-based policymaking and targeted prevention strategies;
